request.spec:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
You can now assign the viewer role, and a viewer can see everything but change nothing. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec. The spec doesn't press any bulk button as a viewer, so the bulk behaviour below is built but not tested.

**How it works:**
- **Database:** new migration `V32__role_viewer.sql` allows `viewer` as a role. The table had to be rebuilt to do it, because the old check on the role column has no name and can't be dropped by name.
- **Assigning the role:** `Role.java` gains the viewer role, and both the server check (`ValidateRole.java`) and the role form (`access.slot.tsx`) now accept clerk, steward or viewer. Permission lists (`perm-*`) still only accept clerk and steward, so no setting can let a viewer take an action.
- **Refusing changes:** a new step, `access/RefuseViewer.java`, runs straight after the body is checked in every endpoint that changes something. That covers 22 endpoints, including today, settings, rates, roles, people, hold, retire, statements, patrons, claims, paste, quick-add, periods and claim actions. It refuses a viewer with "A viewer may not change anything on this sheet" before anything is written, so the usual error shows and nothing reaches the store or the audit file.
- **Bulk buttons:** this app only has bulk open and bulk settle. For a viewer, `OpenClaims.java` and `SettleClaims.java` return straight away with 0 done and every selected claim refused, and no error shows. The other bulk buttons (reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) and the generate buttons (periods, fiscal year, quarters, plans) named in the request don't exist here, so there was nothing to change for them.

Loading a sheet (`PUT /api/sheets/{id}`) and signing in are unchanged, since neither changes any data.
